lastText: The Case Is ClosedThe WomanNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 29BOHEMIAN SCANDAL AVERTED: A KING'S BETROTHAL ANNOUNCEDThe photograph never comes home. The King is betrothed in June, to a princess of Scandinavia, and is reconciled to the thought that he has been beaten by a woman who would not have used her victory. You keep the portrait. You do not speak of her, and Watson, who is wise enough not to ask, only notices that when you are asked for a name which stands for brilliance and for grace you do not say your own. To Sherlock Holmes she is always the Woman, and the Woman, at the end of the case, is wise enough to leave the field with all her honours. He is remembered as the world prefers to remember him: sharp, odd, brilliant and a little aloof.
